_comment: Narrative property definitions for the working plan (v2). NAMES, ORDER, AND FLAGS ONLY.
There is deliberately no field here for Question, Explanation, or a value's Description:
those carry Brian's framing and are authored in the app's Definitions tab. Because the
config cannot express them, no re-run of this op can overwrite that work.
The four axes are the settled geopolitical grid of the fabula, transcribed from the design
conversation 'Political Axes Of The Fabula' (2026-04-23) after its two in-conversation
corrections: axis 1's anti-pole reframed as the industrial baseline rather than a reaction,
and the original Isolationist/Interventionist axis replaced by Boundary.
Two poles per axis, single-select. Adding degrees later is a data operation, not a code
change: add value rows here (or in the Definitions tab) and re-run.
This op assigns NOTHING to any subject. Placing a civilizational system on an axis is
authorial categorization and happens only in the app.
